korean: 아이들은 어디에 불이 났는가 보려고 소방차를 따라 뛰어갔다.
translation: The children ran after the fire truck to see where the fire was.

korean: 나도 김치찌개를 잘 끓인다는 얘기를 듣지만 할머니 솜씨를 따르려면 아직 멀었다.
translation: I also hear that I cook kimchi stew well, but I still have a long way to go to match my grandmother's skill.
To follow the order of events.

korean: 여성의 교육 수준이 높아짐에 따라 여성의 권리도 신장되고 있다.
translation: As women's education level rises, women's rights are also improving.

korean: 그녀의 목소리는 유리 위에서 따르르 구슬이 굴러가는 소리처럼 까랑까랑했다.
translation: Her voice was crisp, like the sound of glass beads rolling on glass.

korean: 따르릉 소리 안 들리니? 대체 언제까지 잘 거야?
translation: Can't you hear it ringing? Just how long are you going to sleep?

korean: 유민이는 승규가 하는 말을 그저 가만히 듣고 있을 따름이었다.
translation: Yumin was simply listening quietly to what Seunggyu was saying.

korean: 김 과장은 여자 따먹은 이야기를 떠벌리고 다녀 회사 내에서 평판이 안 좋다.
translation: Section Chief Kim is bad-mouthed in the company because he goes around bragging about sleeping with women.
To fire off a submachine gun.

korean: 훈련이 시작되자 군인들은 따발총을 메고 훈련장으로 향했다.
translation: When training began, the soldiers slung submachine guns over their shoulders and headed to the training grounds.
To speak like a machine gun.

korean: 나는 주말이면 따사로이 내리쬐는 아침 햇살에 잠에서 깬다.
translation: On weekends, I wake up to the morning sunlight beating down warmly.

korean: 엄마, 저 친구 만나러 나갔다 올게요.
translation: Mom, I'm going out to meet a friend.

korean: 그 밴드는 노래 제목을 신화 속 등장인물에서 따온 이름으로 지었다.
translation: The band named their song after a mythical character.
vegetables such as onions, pumpkins, and eggplants

korean: 증거가 불충분해서 경찰은 용의자가 범인인지 아닌지 따질 수가 없었다.
translation: Because there was insufficient evidence, the police could not determine whether the suspect was the culprit.

korean: 지수는 두 핸드폰을 두고 기능을 따져 보고 더 많은 기능이 들어 있는 핸드폰을 구입했다.
translation: Jisu examined the functions of the two cell phones and bought the one with more features.
Have you set the dates for summer vacation?

korean: 매출액으로 따지면 우리 회사도 대기업에 속하나 회사의 규모는 매우 작다.
translation: In terms of sales revenue, our company qualifies as a large enterprise, but the actual size of the company is very small.

korean: 지수는 동료들에게 힘든 일은 하기 싫다고 처음부터 딱 잘라 말했다.
translation: Jisu told her colleagues firmly right from the start that she didn't want to do hard work.

korean: 건설 현장에는 백 년 된 소나무가 딱 가로막고 서 있어 공사에 차질을 빚고 있다.
translation: At the construction site, a hundred-year-old pine tree is standing right in the way, causing delays in the work.

korean: 반찬이 마음에 들지 않는 아이는 젓가락만 딱딱대고 있었다.
translation: The child, who didn't like the side dishes, was just clacking chopsticks together.

korean: 오븐에 가재를 굽자 가재 딱지가 빨갛게 변했다.
translation: When the crayfish was roasted in the oven, its shell turned red.

korean: 이 제품에는 품질 인증 딱지가 붙어 있어 소비자들이 안심하고 구매한다.
translation: This product has a quality certification mark attached to it, so consumers can buy it with confidence.

korean: 그는 어렸을 때 저지른 도둑질로 평생을 전과자라는 딱지가 붙어 제대로 취직을 할 수 없었다.
translation: Because of a theft he committed as a child, he was labeled an ex-convict for life and could not get a proper job.

korean: 아이들이 딱총의 심지에 불을 붙이자 ‘지글지글’ 소리를 내다 ‘펑’ 하고 터졌다.
translation: When the children lit the firecracker's fuse, it sizzled and then popped with a boom.

korean: 바닷가에 놀러 간 민준이는 친구들과 함께 딱총을 터뜨려 불꽃놀이를 하며 놀았다.
translation: Minjun, who went to the beach, set off firecrackers with his friends and played with fireworks.

korean: 딱총이 터지는 소리에 놀란 아이가 울기 시작했다.
translation: Frightened by the sound of a cap gun popping, the child started to cry.
To be put in an awkward spot.

korean: 그 회사는 공장 이전을 두고 찬성과 반대의 의견이 첨예하게 대립해 결정을 내리기가 딱히 돼 버렸다.
translation: The company was in an awkward situation to make a decision because opinions for and against relocating the factory were sharply divided.

korean: 선생님의 질문에 대한 답을 모르는 지수는 딴말을 해 댔다.
translation: Jisu, who didn't know the answer to the teacher's question, kept talking about completely unrelated things.
To blurt out a conflicting statement.

korean: 수업 시간에 창문을 바라보고 있는 학생에게 선생님은 딴생각 말고 수업에 집중하라고 충고했다.
translation: The teacher advised the student looking out the window during class not to let their mind wander and to focus on the lesson.

korean: 이곳에 공장을 지으려는 회사는 마을 사람들이 딴소리가 나오지 않도록 잘 설득을 했다.
translation: The company trying to build a factory here persuaded the villagers well so that no complaints or objections would arise.
Come to think of it, that's correct.

korean: 하루 종일 책상에만 앉아 있는다고 해서 능률이 오르지 않는다는 학생들의 말을 들으니 딴은 그럴 듯도 하다.
translation: Hearing the students say that efficiency doesn't increase just by sitting at a desk all day, it actually sounds plausible.

korean: 아파트가 모델 하우스와는 영 딴판으로 시공돼 입주자들의 불만을 샀다.
translation: The apartment was built completely differently from the model home, drawing complaints from the residents.

korean: 아파트 현관문이 딸가닥 소리와 함께 저절로 잠겼다.
translation: The front door of the apartment locked itself with a click sound.
to turn into a red nose

korean: 수업 시간에 한 학생이 크게 딸꾹질해서 모두가 웃었다.
translation: During class, a student hiccuped loudly, making everyone laugh.

korean: 두부 장수는 매일 아침 종을 딸랑 울리며 동네 앞을 지나간다.
translation: The tofu seller passes by the neighborhood every morning, ringing his bell with a jingle.

korean: 가게 주인은 멀리서도 손님이 들어오는지 확인하기 위해 문에 딸랑딸랑 소리가 나는 방울을 달았다.
translation: The shop owner hung a jingle-jangling bell on the door so he could tell even from afar when a customer entered.

korean: 아기가 안 울고 혼자 잘 노네요.
translation: The baby isn't crying and is playing well by himself.
to send someone with one's mother.

korean: 아버지는 할머니가 외출하실 때 아들을 딸려 보내 짐을 들게 했다.
translation: When Grandmother went out, Father sent his son along with her to carry her bags.
a father blessed with many daughters.

korean: 딸이 셋인 그 부부는 올해 또 딸을 출산해 딸부자가 되었다.
translation: The couple, who already had three daughters, gave birth to another daughter this year and now have a big family of daughters.

korean: 그녀는 딸애의 건강을 위해 과자를 사 주지 않는다고 말했다.
translation: She said she doesn't buy snacks for her daughter for the sake of her health.

korean: 지수는 목과 등의 땀띠를 없애려고 갖은 방법을 써 봤지만 가려움만 더 심해졌다.
translation: Jisu tried all sorts of methods to get rid of the heat rash on her neck and back, but the itching only got worse.

korean: 무더운 날씨 때문에 승규의 이마에는 땀방울이 잔뜩 맺혔다.
translation: Because of the sweltering weather, Seunggyu's forehead was covered in beads of sweat.
To be born on this land.

korean: 인구는 자꾸 늘어나는데 집을 지을 땅이 부족해서 문제이다.
translation: The population keeps growing, but the problem is that there is not enough land to build houses on.

korean: 집주인이 일주일 내에 집을 비워 달라고 하여 어머니는 땅이 꺼지도록 한숨을 쉬셨다.
translation: When the landlord asked us to vacate the house within a week, my mother let out a deep, heavy sigh.

korean: 왜 그렇게 땅이 꺼지게 한숨을 쉬어?
translation: Why are you sighing so deeply?

korean: 김 씨는 계약금을 뺀 나머지 땅값을 모두 지불했다.
translation: Mr. Kim paid all of the remaining price for the land except for the down payment.

korean: 그 소식은 땅끝 오지에까지 널리 퍼졌다.
translation: The news spread far and wide, even to the remotest corners of the earth.

korean: 절망의 땅끝에서도 희망은 찾을 수 있다.
translation: Hope can be found even at the abyss of despair.
Is your younger sibling tall like you?

korean: 땅값이 자꾸 비싸져서 땅마지기라도 사기가 어려워졌다.
translation: As land prices kept going up, it became difficult to buy even a small plot of land.

korean: 민준이는 버스를 탈 때 집에서 지갑을 두고 왔다는 것을 깨달았다.
translation: Minjun realized he had left his wallet at home when he was getting on the bus.

korean: 유민이는 남자 친구를 만날 때 항상 예쁘게 꾸미고 나간다.
translation: Yumin always dresses up pretty whenever she meets her boyfriend.

korean: 휴학을 끝내고 학교로 돌아왔을 때는 나는 마치 신입생이 된 것 같은 기분이었다.
translation: When I returned to school after taking a leave of absence, I felt like I had become a freshman again.

korean: 이건 제가 신청만 하면 되는 건가요?
translation: Do I just need to apply for this?

korean: 지수는 중요한 면접을 앞두고 때 빼고 광내느라 바쁘다.
translation: Jisu is busy sprucing herself up ahead of an important interview.

korean: 기상 상황이 안 좋아서 비행기가 때늦게 이륙했다.
translation: The plane took off late due to bad weather conditions.

korean: 오빠는 집에 든 도둑을 몽둥이로 때려누인 뒤 경찰에 신고했다.
translation: My older brother knocked down the burglar who entered the house with a club and then reported it to the police.

korean: 승규는 잘 다니던 직장을 때려치우고 유학을 가기로 결정했다.
translation: Seunggyu quit a good job he was working at and decided to go abroad to study.

korean: 우리도 때로는 좀 진지한 대화를 해 보자.
translation: Let's have a somewhat serious conversation for a change.

korean: 오뚝이는 아무리 때려도 넘어지지 않고 다시 일어선다.
translation: No matter how much you hit a roly-poly toy, it doesn't fall down and stands right back up.
How was it when you first went to Daegu?

korean: 지수는 충치를 약간의 때움질로는 치료할 수 없어서 아예 뽑아 버렸다.
translation: Jisoo couldn't treat her cavity with a simple filling, so she had it extracted altogether.

korean: 석탄을 본격적으로 쓰기까지 숲은 땔나무와 숯을 공급하는 유일한 에너지원이었다.
translation: Until coal came into full use, forests were the sole energy source providing firewood and charcoal.

korean: 땜질 그만하고 그냥 새로 사지 그래?
translation: Why don't you stop patching it up and just buy a new one?

korean: 할머니는 늦가을이면 땡감을 꿰어 곶감을 만드셨다.
translation: In late autumn, my grandmother would string unripe persimmons together to make dried persimmons.
To play hooky all day long.

korean: 회사에서 일하기 싫어서 하루 종일 땡땡이쳤더니 해야 할 일이 쌓였다.
translation: I didn't want to work at the office, so I slacked off all day, and now my work has piled up.

korean: 뜨거운 땡볕 아래에서 한 시간이나 서 있었더니 땀이 비 오듯이 쏟아졌다.
translation: Standing under the scorching sun for a whole hour made me sweat buckets.

korean: 땡볕이 강하게 내리쬐는 날에는 외출할 때 양산이나 선글라스를 준비하는 것이 좋다.
translation: On days when the sun beats down harshly, it is a good idea to take a parasol or sunglasses when going out.

korean: 졸업 이후 하나둘씩 고향을 떠나가더니 이제 이 마을에서 젊은이들을 찾아보기가 힘들다.
translation: After graduation, people left their hometown one by one, and now it is hard to find young people in this village.

korean: 선생님의 질문에 아이들은 교실이 떠나갈 듯이 대답했다.
translation: To the teacher's question, the children answered loudly enough to shake the classroom.
To scoop up water from a well.

korean: 직접 물고기를 잡아 즉석에서 회를 떠내어 먹으니 신선하고 맛이 좋았다.
translation: It was fresh and delicious to catch the fish ourselves and immediately fillet and eat it on the spot.

korean: 승규는 전국의 장터를 떠다니며 장사를 했다.
translation: Seunggyu did business while traveling around markets across the country.

korean: 너도 아버지 따라 고향에서 농사지으며 살 거니?
translation: Are you also going to live in your hometown doing farm work like your father?
To wander as a lost soul.
I heard you went on a world trip with your husband?
The market is always bustling because there are many people.

korean: 친구들이 내 등을 힘껏 떠밀어 나를 물에 빠뜨렸다.
translation: My friends pushed hard on my back and made me fall into the water.
To lift with all one's strength.
To treat one's husband with high respect.

korean: 승규는 술만 마시면 자기가 최고라고 시끄럽게 떠벌린다.
translation: Whenever Seunggyu drinks, he loudly brags that he is the best.

korean: 시내에 음식점을 떠벌이기는 했는데 손님이 많지 않아 걱정이다.
translation: I launched a restaurant downtown, but I'm worried because there aren't many customers.

korean: 처음부터 빚을 내어 많은 부담을 떠안고 사업을 시작하는 것은 바람직하지 않다.
translation: It is not desirable to start a business with a heavy burden by taking out loans from the beginning.

korean: 아들 내외와 손주 녀석들이 집에 오면 노부부의 얼굴에 웃음이 떠오른다.
translation: When their son, daughter-in-law, and grandchildren come home, a smile appears on the elderly couple's faces.
to bring a smile to one's lips.

korean: 그는 떡 먹듯 거짓말을 해 사람들에게 미움을 샀다.
translation: He lied casually as if eating rice cake, making people dislike him.

korean: 그는 자기보다 훨씬 덩치 큰 사내들을 떡 주무르듯 때려 눕혔다.
translation: He beat up and knocked down men much bigger than him with total ease.

korean: 그가 시키는 대로 그곳에 투자를 해 보았지만 떡이 생기기는커녕 오히려 큰 손해만 보았다.
translation: I tried investing there as he told me to, but far from making a profit, I ended up suffering a huge loss.

korean: 이번 설에는 회사 사정이 어려워서 떡값이 안 나온대.
translation: I heard the company isn't giving out a holiday bonus this Lunar New Year because business is tough.

korean: 회사가 고수익을 올려야 주주들한테도 떡고물이 떨어진다.
translation: The company needs to make high profits for the shareholders to get a piece of the pie as well.

korean: 설날 아침에는 떡국을 먹어야 복을 받는다는 속설이 있다.
translation: There is a popular belief that you receive good luck if you eat sliced rice cake soup on New Year's Day morning.

korean: 어머니는 떡두꺼비 같은 아들만 하나 낳아 오라고 늘 말씀하셨다.
translation: Mother always told me to come back after having a healthy, chubby baby boy.
To hold a rice cake mallet.

korean: 떡메로 쳐서 떡은 만들었는데 이 다음엔 뭘 해야 돼요?
translation: We pounded the rice with mallets to make rice cake, so what should we do next?
To put paste bait on a hook.

korean: 친구는 돌아가신 어머니 이야기를 하다가 눈물을 뚝뚝 떨구었다.
translation: My friend shed tears, dripping down, while talking about their deceased mother.
Why are you walking with your head hanging down like that?
To open the door with a click.
To lock the padlock with a click.

korean: 우리는 죽을지도 모른다는 공포에 떨면서 하루하루를 살았다.
translation: We lived day by day, trembling in fear that we might die.
He must have been nervous because his voice trembled severely.

korean: 아버지는 먼지떨이를 들고 집 안 곳곳에 쌓인 먼지를 떨어내셨다.
translation: Father picked up a duster and shook off the dust that had accumulated all over the house.

korean: 사냥꾼은 날아가는 꿩을 쏘아 아래로 떨어뜨렸다.
translation: The hunter shot the flying pheasant and brought it down.

korean: 의사의 수를 줄이면 의료 서비스의 질을 떨어뜨리게 된다.
translation: Reducing the number of doctors will lower the quality of medical services.

korean: 그는 거짓으로 연구 결과를 발표함으로써 대학의 명예를 떨어뜨렸다.
translation: He brought dishonor upon the university by publishing false research results.

korean: 우리 군은 진지가 적군에 떨어지지 않도록 최선을 다해 싸웠다.
translation: Our army fought with all their might so that the position would not fall to the enemy.

korean: 나는 늘 욕을 하는 친구에게 정나미가 떨어진다.
translation: I lose all affection for my friend, who is always swearing.
to fall behind the lead group
to be about a hundred meters away.

korean: 민준이는 해 떨어지기 전에 집에 도착하려고 자리에서 일찍 일어섰다.
translation: Minjun got up early from his seat to reach home before the sun set.

korean: 의사 선생님, 환자분의 숨이 곧 떨어지려고 합니다.
translation: Doctor, the patient is about to draw their last breath.

korean: 임산부는 혹시나 애가 떨어질까 봐 모든 행동을 조심하였다.
translation: The pregnant woman was careful in everything she did, worried that she might miscarry.

korean: 그 할머니의 연세는 여든에서 한두 살이 떨어지는 일흔 여덟쯤이다.
translation: The grandmother's age is about seventy-eight, a year or two short of eighty.

korean: 나와 눈이 마주치자 지수는 급히 시선을 땅으로 떨어트렸다.
translation: When our eyes met, Jisu quickly lowered her gaze to the ground.

korean: 엔진 오일을 떨어트린 걸 계속 몰랐던 거 있지.
translation: You know, I didn't realize for a long time that I had run out of engine oil.
